metadata.title: SEC EDGAR Early Mover Snapshot
metadata.source: SEC EDGAR submissions JSON, 13F-HR information tables, and Schedule 13D/13G filings
metadata.caveat: 13F data is delayed, long-only for reportable securities, can omit shorts/swaps/non-13F instruments, and does not reveal current intent. Schedule 13D/G filings are more timely ownership disclosures but still do not prove current trading intent. Treat this as a context signal, not a trade instruction.
